metadata.name: Panchang Reference Dataset
metadata.description: Classical Vedic Panchang and Muhurtha reference tables covering 30 Tithis, 9 Taras, 11 Karanas, 27 Nitya Yogas, Rahu Kalam schedules, and Muhurtha action recommendations.
metadata.author: AstroGuide Engineering Team

tithis.name: Pratipada
tithis.description: First lunar day of the waxing moon. Ruled by Agni; carries moderate energy suited for spiritual and purification rites.

tithis.name: Dwitiya
tithis.description: Highly auspicious Bhadra tithi ruled by Lord Brahma. Excellent for constructive, creative, and family milestones.

tithis.name: Tritiya
tithis.description: Victorious Jaya tithi ruled by Goddess Gauri. Known for enduring prosperity, aesthetic elegance, and auspicious beginnings.

tithis.name: Chaturthi
tithis.description: Rikta (empty) tithi ruled by Saturn. Inauspicious for worldly ventures; dedicated to Ganesha worship for overcoming hurdles.

tithis.name: Panchami
tithis.description: Full Poorna tithi ruled by Jupiter. Brings expansive healing, intellectual advancement, and marital harmony.

tithis.name: Shashthi
tithis.description: Nanda tithi ruled by Kartikeya. Possesses vigorous martial energy suited for courage, leadership, and health therapies.

tithis.name: Saptami
auspicious_activities: Embarking on political or executive initiatives
tithis.description: Auspicious Bhadra tithi ruled by Sun God Surya. Illuminates professional vitality, travel, and public honors.

tithis.name: Ashtami
tithis.description: Challenging Jaya tithi with sharp transformative energy. Traditionally avoided for major worldly ventures; potent for Devi worship.

tithis.name: Navami
tithis.description: Rikta (empty) tithi ruled by Saturn. Inauspicious for gentle creative affairs; optimal for resolving conflicts and cutting ties.

tithis.name: Dashami
tithis.description: Supreme Poorna tithi ruled by Dharma. Bestows victory, leadership recognition, civic honour, and enduring success.

tithis.name: Ekadashi
tithis.description: Highly auspicious spiritual tithi. Promotes clarity of mind, karmic cleansing, and lasting divine blessings.

tithis.name: Dwadashi
auspicious_activities: Breaking Ekadashi fast at auspicious hora
tithis.description: Moderate Bhadra tithi ruled by Mercury. Conducive for scholarly pursuits, vow fulfillment, and peaceful domestic chores.

tithis.name: Trayodashi
tithis.description: Victorious Jaya tithi ruled by Kamadeva. Overflowing with joy, sensual grace, social harmony, and spiritual redemption.

tithis.name: Chaturdashi
tithis.description: Rikta tithi ruled by Saturn. Inauspicious for worldly celebrations; potent for rigorous meditation and overcoming deep fears.

tithis.name: Purnima
tithis.description: The Full Moon. Peak Poorna tithi brimming with radiant soma. Magnificent for spiritual illumination, celebrations, and goodwill.

tithis.name: Pratipada
tithis.description: First tithi of the waning moon. Suitable for gradual winding down, quiet analysis, and routine persistence.

tithis.name: Dwitiya
tithis.description: Auspicious waning Bhadra tithi. Fosters dependable business dealings, organizational planning, and educational research.

tithis.name: Tritiya
tithis.description: Jaya tithi ruled by Gauri. Carries steady momentum for competitive activities, artisanal crafts, and building stamina.

tithis.name: Chaturthi
tithis.description: Rikta tithi ruled by Saturn. Avoid worldly celebrations; ideal for Sankashti Chaturthi fast to dissolve mounting debts and grief.

tithis.name: Panchami
tithis.description: Poorna tithi ruled by Jupiter. Well-favored for restorative healthcare, structured governance, and educational development.

tithis.name: Shashthi
tithis.description: Neutral Nanda tithi ruled by Kartikeya. Good for energetic tasks requiring willpower, grit, and physical effort.

tithis.name: Saptami
tithis.description: Auspicious Bhadra tithi ruled by Surya. Provides stable solar energy for transport, administrative matters, and vitality.

tithis.name: Ashtami
tithis.description: Inauspicious worldly tithi with intense, severe energy. Revered for Kala Bhairava puja and shedding stubborn negative habits.

tithis.name: Navami
tithis.description: Rikta tithi ruled by Saturn. Inauspicious for gentle beginnings; suitable for resolute boundary setting and conflict resolution.

tithis.name: Dashami
tithis.description: Poorna tithi ruled by Jupiter. Well-suited for principled governance, strategic realignments, and educational study.

tithis.name: Ekadashi
tithis.description: Sacred Krishna Ekadashi. Purifies bodily and spiritual sheaths through fasting, prayer, and selfless humanitarian deeds.

tithis.name: Dwadashi
tithis.description: Moderate Bhadra tithi ruled by Mercury. Promotes peaceful introspection, settling accounts, and gentle charitable deeds.

tithis.name: Trayodashi
tithis.description: Auspicious Jaya tithi before the dark moon. Holy Pradosham window for washing away karmic debts and receiving Shiva's grace.

tithis.name: Chaturdashi
tithis.description: Rikta tithi ruled by Saturn. Highly challenging for mundane affairs; supreme night for Shivaratri meditation and self-mastery.

tithis.name: Amavasya
tithis.description: The New Moon. The lunar disc is absent; rays turn inward. Worldly muhurthas strictly avoided; consecrated for honoring departed ancestors.

taras.name: Janma
taras.description: Pertains to physical body, self, and health. High sensitivity to bodily vulnerability. Favorable for personal introspection and spiritual rites, but best to avoid medical surgeries or strenuous journeys.

taras.name: Sampat
taras.description: Brings wealth, financial abundance, and commercial prosperity. Extremely auspicious for business inaugurations, purchasing assets, signing agreements, and banking.
avoid_actions: None; highly beneficial for commercial progress

taras.name: Vipat
taras.description: Indicates unexpected obstacles, accidents, financial leakage, and misunderstandings. Great caution needed in all dealings.

taras.name: Kshema
taras.description: Fosters safety, well-being, domestic peace, and smooth execution. Favorable for family celebrations, entering homes, signing contracts, and recovery from illness.

taras.name: Pratyari
taras.description: Symbolizes enemies, confrontations, counter-actions, and friction. Unfavorable for diplomacy, partnership formation, or delicate negotiations.

taras.name: Sadhaka
taras.description: Brings achievement, goal realization, academic success, and fulfillment of ambitions. Excellent for high-level meetings, exams, and spiritual milestones.

taras.name: Vadha
taras.description: Also known as Naidhana. The most malefic tara in Jyotish. Danger of severe loss, breakdown, and mortal failure. Strictly avoid major initiatives.

taras.name: Mitra
taras.description: Promotes harmony, friendly assistance, enjoyable social gatherings, and reliable alliances. Favorable for romantic commitments, networking, and joint ventures.

taras.name: Ati-Mitra
taras.description: Extremely favorable tara bringing intense goodwill, extraordinary cooperation, deep affection, and unyielding support.

highly_auspicious.label: Highly Auspicious
highly_auspicious.description: All three pillars (Tithi, Chandrabala, Tarabala) are in harmonious alignment. Optimal cosmic support.
action_templates: An excellent day for new beginnings and important decisions.
Ideal for initiating long-term projects and signing contracts.
A wonderful time for celebrations and significant purchases.
Great for starting new educational pursuits or investments.
Favorable for important meetings and spiritual practices.

neutral.label: Neutral / Moderate
neutral.description: A mixed balance of celestial forces. Suitable for regular everyday affairs without extraordinary risks.
action_templates: A good day for routine tasks and personal reflection.
Focus on maintaining current projects and steady progress.
Ideal for organizing, planning, and consolidating resources.
Favorable for catching up on administrative work.
A suitable day for quiet work and attending to details.

inauspicious_avoid.label: Inauspicious / Avoid
inauspicious_avoid.description: Severe conflicting energies across Tithi, Chandrabala, and Tarabala. Postpone major milestones.
action_templates: Focus on completing ongoing projects and nurturing relationships.
Best to avoid major new initiatives today.
A day for reflection, meditation, and finishing pending tasks.
Exercise caution in financial dealings and travel.
Keep a low profile and avoid aggressive moves.

rahu_kalam_rules.base_calculation: Daytime divided into 8 equal parts of approximately 90 minutes each between 06:00 and 18:00.
rahu_kalam_rules.proscription: Strictly avoid commencing any auspicious deed, travel, medical procedure, or contract signing during Rahu Kalam.

karanas.name: Bava
karanas.nature: Promotes health, army strength, statecraft, and public achievements.

karanas.name: Balava
karanas.nature: Auspicious for sacred ceremonies, rituals, and learning.

karanas.name: Kaulava
karanas.nature: Bestows friendship, partnerships, romance, and artistic endeavours.

karanas.name: Taitila
karanas.nature: Favorable for construction, securing positions, buying homes.

karanas.name: Garija
karanas.nature: Excellent for agriculture, planting, commerce, and laying foundations.

karanas.name: Vanija
karanas.nature: Supreme for trade, financial transactions, and merchant agreements.

karanas.name: Vishti
karanas.nature: Also known as Bhadra. Strictly inauspicious for worldly beginnings; suited for warfare and defense.

karanas.name: Shakuni
karanas.nature: Fixed karana. Suitable for administering medicine, remedies, and occult disciplines.

karanas.name: Chatushpada
karanas.nature: Fixed karana. Favorable for ancestral shraddha, cattle welfare, and state actions.

karanas.name: Naga
karanas.nature: Fixed karana. Destructive energy; suitable only for subduing enemies and boundary disputes.

karanas.name: Kintughna
karanas.nature: Fixed karana. Brings joy, auspicious deeds, charity, and religious sacrifice.

nitya_yogas.name: Vishkambha
nitya_yogas.effect: Creates initial obstructions; requires persistence.

nitya_yogas.name: Priti
nitya_yogas.effect: Fosters goodwill, mutual affection, and happy social gatherings.

nitya_yogas.name: Ayushman
nitya_yogas.effect: Bestows longevity, enduring health, and sustainable growth.

nitya_yogas.name: Saubhagya
nitya_yogas.effect: Brings auspicious fortune, marital felicity, and prosperity.

nitya_yogas.name: Shobhana
nitya_yogas.effect: Grants aesthetic beauty, artistic flair, and bright prospects.

nitya_yogas.name: Atiganda
nitya_yogas.effect: Severe complications; avoid major new ventures.

nitya_yogas.name: Sukarma
nitya_yogas.effect: Supreme for righteous actions, charity, and noble enterprise.

nitya_yogas.name: Dhriti
nitya_yogas.effect: Grants patience, moral courage, and stability.

nitya_yogas.name: Shoola
nitya_yogas.effect: Sharp discord, pain, and conflict; avoid surgeries and travel.

nitya_yogas.name: Ganda
nitya_yogas.effect: Challenging conditions; beware of deceit and mishaps.

nitya_yogas.name: Vriddhi
nitya_yogas.effect: Multiplies prosperity, wealth, and intellectual progress.

nitya_yogas.name: Dhruva
nitya_yogas.effect: Excellent for long-term construction, agreements, and coronation.

nitya_yogas.name: Vyaghata
nitya_yogas.effect: Fierce destructive potential; avoid all peaceful ventures.

nitya_yogas.name: Harshana
nitya_yogas.effect: Generates cheerfulness, celebration, and creative success.

nitya_yogas.name: Vajra
nitya_yogas.effect: Harsh, unyielding power; unfavorable for gentle ceremonies.

nitya_yogas.name: Siddhi
nitya_yogas.effect: Bestows accomplishment of goals, spiritual powers, and wealth.

nitya_yogas.name: Vyatipata
nitya_yogas.effect: Highly inauspicious for worldly beginnings; suited for meditation.

nitya_yogas.name: Variyan
nitya_yogas.effect: Encourages luxury, contentment, and high status.

nitya_yogas.name: Parigha
nitya_yogas.effect: Encountering resistance; first half is especially afflicted.

nitya_yogas.name: Shiva
nitya_yogas.effect: Deeply auspicious for spiritual wisdom, healing, and peace.

nitya_yogas.name: Siddha
nitya_yogas.effect: Auspicious for religious rituals, learning, and craftsmanship.

nitya_yogas.name: Sadhya
nitya_yogas.effect: Fosters cooperative success and steady progress.

nitya_yogas.name: Shubha
nitya_yogas.effect: Magnificent for weddings, business, and auspicious ceremonies.

nitya_yogas.name: Shukla
nitya_yogas.effect: Promotes clear insight, truthfulness, and vitality.

nitya_yogas.name: Brahma
nitya_yogas.effect: Superlative for intellectual and spiritual wisdom.

nitya_yogas.name: Indra
nitya_yogas.effect: Brings leadership respect, executive promotions, and power.

nitya_yogas.name: Vaidhriti
nitya_yogas.effect: Chaotic energies; avoid commencing material ventures.
